items.title: Education & Girl-Child Support
items.summary: Education pathways and protection for under-age girls, survivors of abuse, and under-resourced mothers — keeping girls in school and building routes to self-sufficiency.
items.detail: Education pathways and protection for under-age girls, survivors of sexual violence and forced marriage, and under-resourced mothers in rural settings — combining schooling support with routes to self-sufficiency.
items.donateBlurb: schooling and protection pathways for girls and under-resourced mothers.

items.title: Child Welfare & Protection
items.summary: Healthcare, shelter and education for sick, impoverished, abandoned and orphaned children — and removal of children from abusive environments into schooling and psychosocial support.
items.detail: Healthcare, shelter and education for sick, impoverished, abandoned and orphaned children — plus active removal of children from abusive environments, with schooling and psychosocial support through recovery and reintegration.
items.donateBlurb: healthcare, shelter, education and safe recovery for vulnerable children.
items.cardImageAlt: Healthcare, shelter and protection for children in need
items.thumbImageAlt: Healthcare, shelter and education support for children

items.title: Feeding & Community Relief
items.summary: Food packs and community relief for households in acute need — reaching families that mainstream support too often misses, so children stay fed and in school.
items.detail: Food packs and community relief for households in acute need — stabilising families so children stay fed, in school and cared for while longer-term support takes root.
items.donateBlurb: food packs and relief for households in acute need.

items.thumbImageAlt: Bread and food packs prepared for community distribution

items.title: Women & Widow Empowerment
items.summary: Financial and emotional support for young widows facing sudden loss — stabilising households and rebuilding sustainable livelihoods.
items.detail: Financial and emotional support for young widows facing sudden loss, helping them stabilize households and rebuild sustainable livelihoods.
items.donateBlurb: helping widows stabilize households and rebuild livelihoods.
